results.description: The youthful Turtles take their first trip without Master Splinter, seeking out a fresh water supply that they discovered on a mysterious map that Donatello found in an old book about the origins of New York City. After exploring long forgotten parts of the sewers, the mutants discover more than just water.
results.name: Not Forgotten

results.description: Master Splinter fights a psychic battle against one of the Foot Clan's Mystic Warriors.
results.name: Seeds of Destruction

results.description: A Foot Mystic uses sorcery to reconjure the Shredder clone worms into a more nefarious foe.
results.name: The Worms of Madness, Part 1

results.description: The TMNT seek the aid of the powerful mystic Pai-Doth Noor who frees them from the Spell of Reversal and transports them to the spot where the Foot Mystic and Shredder shark monster are planning to use Splinter's body to host the clone worms.
results.name: The Worms of Madness, Part 2

results.description: Leonardo is poisoned by a mysterious ninja. The powerful drug robs the mutant turtle of his eyesight, just as his foe launches an attack! Leo must fight for his life against a powerful adversary that he cannot see.
results.name: Blind Faith

results.description: The creative team from "TMNT Adventures" reunites in the Mirage Turtles universe to tell the tale of how Cha Ocho became Leonardo's bitter enemy.
results.name: Scars / The Raisin

results.description: Shadow sneaks out of the Turtles' lair to attend a concert where she finds much more lunacy than she ever dreamed. Fortunately her "uncles" show up when things get hairy.
results.name: Darkness Weaves

results.description: Raphael, suffering from a cold, goes out for some air and runs into a trophy hunting ninja. Raph chases the woman into the sewers and runs into Leatherhead, who has been suffering from his own malady.
results.name: Virus

results.description: Klunk the cat is hit by a car and Michelangelo is forced to make some difficult choices while trying to save his life.
results.name: The Path

results.description: Donatello runs into a mythical creature.
results.name: Kaddish

results.description: Master Splinter and the Turtles battle a band of hyperfast ninjas.
results.name: The Quick and the Dead

results.description: Shadow and Raphael encounter trouble in Paris.
results.name: Paris Nocturne

results.description: Leonardo meets incarnations of his past and future in effort to return the favor he owes to Pai-Doth Noor by delivering a "gift".
results.name: Loops, part one

results.description: Leonardo meets incarnations of his past and future in effort to return the favor he owes to Pai-Doth Noor by delivering a "gift".
results.name: Loops, part two

results.description: Shadow, Casey and Mikey take a road trip to visit the site where Gabby's ashes were spread. On their way home, the trio must run the race of their lives against a grease monkey gasser of wigged out proportions.
results.name: Hell's Blacktop

results.description: Donatello visits the Utroms and pilots one of their spacecraft into uncharted space - where he and the Fugitoid encounter an unknown alien species.
results.name: Sins of the Past

results.description: Casey and Raph go out for a night on the town with Glurin and the three decide to test the Utrom scientist's dimensional teleportal machine. Donatello agrees to accompany his brother and Jones on the trip, but what they find is anything but inviting.
results.name: Wrong Turn

results.description: Donatello and Glurin investigate a mystery under the Sargasso Sea.
results.name: Altered Fates

results.description: Master Splinter and the TMNT investigate a haunted house in Japan.
results.name: A Ghost Story

results.description:
This issue contains three short stories:

"The Trophy" - 12 page Master Splinter tale by by Steve Murphy, Ray-Anthony Height and Derek Fridolfs. Splinter deals with some hunters.

"The Cure" - 10 page fish-woman story by Steve Murphy, Jim Lawson and Eric Talbot. The fish-woman takes a journey.

"The Rippling" - 14 page TMNT story by Jake Black, Steve Murphy, Peter Laird, and Fernando Pinto. The Turtles investigate an underwater phenomena.
results.name: The Trophy, The Cure, & The Rippling

results.description: Evil Sheriff Terrorbull steals a magic crystal and uses it to open an interdimensional doorway that takes him (and the pursuing Wild West C.O.W.Boys of Moo Mesa) to New York City, where they meet the TMNT.
results.name: A (Bull) Wrinkle In Time

results.description: Hattori asks the TMNT to help him put an end to his family's corrupt business - but there's more waiting for our heroes in the Goseico building than they were anticipating.
results.name: Change of Power

results.description: The TMNT are summoned to deep space to rescue Leatherhead from a group of Utrom militants... and worse.
results.name: Attack of the Replicants

results.description: Tunnel workers uncover a metallic egg beneath the streets of New York City. When the container opens, its inhabitants open fire and michaelangelo tries a peace talk.
results.name: Rock of Ages

results.description:
This issue features three stories and ten pin-ups.

"Kung-Fu Theatre" - 20 page story by Laird, Murphy, Lawson and Brown (reuniting Lawson and Brown, the original art team on "Tales of the TMNT" volume one).

Pin-Up gallery featuring Dario Brizuela, Eric Talbot, Stan Sakai, Michael Dooney, Sean Wang, Dan Berger, Dave White, Jim Lawson, Don Perlin and Diego Jourdan.

"My Hero!" 5 page story by Jourdan, Laird and Murphy.

"The Doors of Deception" - 6 page Professor Obligado story by Murphy, Lawson and White.
results.name: Kung-Fu Theatre / My Hero! / The Doors of Deception

results.description: Donatello enlists the aid of Raphael and Casey Jones to investigate and unusual New York City sweatshop..one that uses underpaid workers to create "internet gold".
results.name: The Value of Gold

results.description: April goes on a month-long walkabout in the Alaskan wilderness searching for answers after discovering her true origin.
results.name: Tales Of April: White Horses

results.description: Cha Ocho and Raphael share a drink in a local watering hole and then get abducted by aliens.
results.name: Shanghaied / The Channeling

results.description: Donatello explores a mysterious planet in disputed space with Bydex the Utrom and Sellis, a Styracodon. While there, the group uncovers a Triceraton archaelogical dig that's unearthing an ancient weapon of epic proportions.
results.name: Soul Survivor

results.description: Michelangelo encounters anachronistic sorcery when trying to write his novel. Inspired by a panel from TMNT vol.4 Issue #18
results.name: Circle of Darkness / The Mother of All Anger

results.description: Casey, April and Shadow go to an alien impressionist's show where Jones comes face to face with his nightmare self/
results.name: Reflections

results.description: The Wild West C.O.W.Boys of Moo Mesa and the TMNT meet in the Astral Plane where a battle between an ancient terrapin sorcerer named T'sou-T'An-Jin and Savanti Romero takes place over the possession of a powerful artifact called the Eye of Aga-Moo-Tou.
results.name: The Eye of Aga-Moo-Tou

results.description: Shadow is kidnapped, leading Casey Jones and Master Splinter into the maws of a monstrous trap!
results.name: The Bait / Credo

results.description: The Turtles discover who the mysterious female ninja and why she's been collecting Turtle trophies.
results.name: Splinter Cell

results.description: Splinter battles the Rat King!
results.name: The Pantheon / Secret Spirit

results.description: The New York City police run into Foot Clan treachery following the end of "City at War"!
results.name: To Serve and Protect

results.description: Casey Jones tells his origin story to a man that he saved from muggers.
results.name: Casey In Point

results.description:
Donatello tells a story about the Young Teenage Mutant Turtles going to forbidden place in the sewer and meet leatherhead!
Including a back story called "Awww..rats".
results.name: Triptyche / Awww... Rats!

results.description: Its Halloween and raphael see a mystrious man and follows him, suddnlly he transported to the future!
results.name: What Wolves Wear

results.description: Future Raphael attempts to protect an orphaned baby from the Foot Clan.
Future Leonardo and Radical run into Complete Carnage, who destroys the happy couple's romance. Leonardo first seeks solace in forgiveness, until he discovers the villain is devoid of any virtue.
results.name: Swan Song

results.description: Some mysterious men in black interview Casey Jones about a robot that emerged from a crashed UFO.
results.name: The Curious Case of Mr. Jones

results.description: Casey's no-good cousin Sid has joined the Foot Clan as a lowly initiate. In order to advance his standing, the former thug leads Karai to the Jones family farmhouse in Northampton, Massachusetts to ruin Casey and April's engagement party. The ninjas plan to steal the ring in Casey's possession because Sid believes it to be the magical talisman that Karai is seeking.
results.name: The Proposal

results.description: Karai and other Foot initiates go on a quest to unearth an amulet of power. The newbie ninjas find what they seek through hard-fought battles with mythic creatures only to face the most deadly enemy of all - treachery from within!
results.name: The Amulet

results.description: Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo are vacationing in western Massachusetts when Mike is abducted by a group of piscatorial abominations. Raph and Don must rescue their brother before he's sacrificed to the Lovecraftian behemoth the lurks beneath the Quabbin Reservoir!
results.name: Rocks

results.description: "Temps" is a tale that takes place during the "City At War" story line from TMNT Volume One. This issue offers a rare look inside the life of a Foot Clan initiate who comes face to face with the organization's most deadly foes - the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles!
results.name: Temps

results.description: "The Secret Origins of the Super Turtles!!!" - this issue takes us to an alternate dimension where we discover how the super hero Turtles came to be! Alien invaders must be stopped - can Dr. Shreddarius' army of Terrorkinetics™ prevent certain doom - and just whose side are they on? A titanic Turtles tale featuring an epic battle between good and evil that harkens back to the stunning Silver Age of super heroes! 'Nuff said, pilgrims!!
results.name: Ninja No More! The Secret Origins of the Super Turtles!!!

results.description: "The Decider" - A brutal crime wave wrecks havoc upon the streets of Springfield, Massachusetts and all evidence points to the perpetrators as being giant, mutant turtles! Leo, Don, Raph, Mike, Casey Jones and Master Splinter struggle to solve the vicious robberies and find the real mastermind behind them before the TMNT are revealed by the local media!
results.name: The Decider!

results.description: "Mined Games" - Mr. Braunze is back on the scene and we discover what happened in the Nevada desert back in TMNT Volume Two!
results.name: Mined Games

results.description: Leatherhead and the Turtles battle the deadliest creatures on Earth to win back their freedom from big game hunter Mr. Marlin
results.name: World's Deadliest

results.description: "Night of the Living Gingerbread" - Renet visits the Turtles and inadvertently teleports them to the distant past where they encounter all manners of monsters and beasties - including a friendly gingerbread golem named Gutwallow.
results.name: Night of the Living Gingerbread

results.description: 'The Crystal At the Heart of the World,' Part 3. The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles once again team-up with the Wild West C.O.W.Boys of Moo Mesa, but this time the circumstances are more dire, with the fate of the C.O.W.Boys' world at stake, a fate with potential cosmic-wide repercussions! Guest-starring a certain bovine visitor from the 'Archie TMNT' universe!
results.name: The Crystal At The Heart Of The World; The Mission

results.description: Casey has some plumbing work doen on his farmhouse in Northampton, which leads to trouble when the assistant to the plumber decides to steal one of Shadow's rare toys.
results.name: Alien Invaders

results.description: Raphael seriously injures the Fugitoid in a bar room brawl leaving the robotic hero struggling with damaged circuitry, a process that tests Professor Honeycutt's fragile psyche to its outer limits! Featuring the Tales debut of scribe Andrew Bonia and Image Comics art team Bob LeFevre and Mostafa Moussa!
results.name: Mere Appendix

results.description: "A Day in the Life" – this story takes place shortly before TMNT volume 1 #1 and illustrates how the Turtles and their Sensei were preparing in the days that lead up to their conflict with the Shredder and the Foot Clan.
results.name: A Day in the Life

results.description: "Hun" - Before the Shredder, New York City was ruled by one very dangerous man. Now, the Shredder is dead, the Foot Clan is in disarray and that man has been released from prison. Featuring the debut of the greatest threat to face the Turtles since the Shredder himself and revealing the shocking events that truly made Casey Jones the man he is today!
results.name: Hun

results.description: The Turtles are in turmoil, arguing amongst themselves regarding where they should reside. Raph wants to take up residence in an abandoned church, Leo wants to return to the sewers, Don wants to go to Massachusetts and Mike wants to stay in April's building to protect their friends, a plan that seems all the more necessary when a gang attacks a man living next door. The Turtles intervene and find themselves battling enemies new and old - very old!
results.name: Gangs All Here

results.description:
"All Tomorrow's Yesterdays" - A threat from beyond space and time is awakened by a renegade group of Utroms, leaving the fate of not one but two worlds in the hands of the TMNT - our Earth, as well as the alternate Earth of the Wild West C.O.W.-Boys of Moo Mesa! Guest-starring Cudley the Cowlick!

Plus the TMNT back in their IWF costumes, Bebop, Rocksteady, Krang, and the long awaited, long demanded, and unexpected return of The Mighty Mutanimals (for a panel anyway)
results.name: All Tomorrow's Yesterdays

results.description:
Frontispiece: Leonardo is fighting a horde of Foot Ninja while simultaneously dodging arrow fire. He recalls how Splinter taught him about actions and reactions and relates it to his own life. His acts of vengeance upon the Foot have trapped him in a web of retaliation and he ponders how long it will take to escape, or if he’ll even escape at all.

Following Hun’s attack on the Jones family, Casey, April and Shadow have gone into hiding at the Northampton farmhouse.
results.name: Expose

results.description: “Nobody Does It Better” – This action-packed issue features the shocking return of Nobody, the crime-fighting vigilante thought to be slain in “TMNT” volume two #12! We discover the fate of the not-so-fallen hero while Raphael and Casey Jones encounter a new villain with super-human (and extraterrestrial) powers!
results.name: Nobody Does it Better

results.description: World's Deadliest II.' Billionaire munitions master Mr. Marlin escapes death, yet again, and renews his hunt for the Turtles and Leatherhead. Marlin appears to be unstoppable; can our heroes hope to escape both him and the monsters that dwell on the deadly island?
results.name: Monster Island

results.description: Robyn O'Neil is dying of an extremely aggressive form of cancer accidentally introduced to humanity by the Utroms, the Utroms are working on a cure, but by the time they are finished Robyn will be dead. Leaving it up to the TMNT who are shrunk down to microscopic size to do battle with the cancer inside Robyn's body.
results.name: Heroes in a Half Cell

results.description: This issue takes place in the future, where Shadow, who is now an adult and a master of the martial arts, battles the forces of the Foot Clan.
results.name: Dark Shadows

results.description:
Set during the Return to New York story line, Raphael lies in a sewer tunnel, remembering the past few days. The fight with Leo was 4 days ago, yet Raph still feels the pain in his shoulder. He knows at this time that he can't show any sign of weakness, for it's up to him alone to rid the sewers of the overwhelming plague that infests them. He must exterminate the Foot.
Also, what happens when Raph discovers a Triceraton hiding in the sewers along with the foot?
results.name: Return to New York

results.description: The story within is a recreation of TMNT vol. 1 #8 without the copyright issues that were present with the original issue. This was drawn without Dave Sim's Cerebus character by the Spanish publishing house Norma Editorial in 2006 then finally translated in to English for this issue.
results.name: The Paradox of Chudnovsky
